visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged Asian man with rectangular glasses and a professional black collared shirt is positioned centrally in a medium close-up shot. He speaks directly to the lens with an expressive face and clear mouth movements. The background is a dark studio setting featuring abstract, glowing nebula patterns in shades of deep red and cyan, providing a high-tech atmosphere. A small lavalier microphone is visible on his collar. (2) While the man continues speaking, a large, colorful illustrative graphic overlay appears in the lower half of the frame. The graphic depicts a cartoon island with a small adventurer character, a large horned monster, and text in Traditional Chinese titled 'AI 斜槓新手村'. The lighting is focused and bright on the man’s face, separating him from the dark, textured background. (3) The graphic overlay is removed, and the man begins to use his hands for emphasis, gesturing towards the camera. At one point, he holds a blue pen between his fingers to punctuate his points. His expressions are earnest and encouraging, maintaining a consistent eyeline with the audience while he explains the benefits of the course. (4) A second educational infographic replaces the previous one, this time displaying four icon-based boxes labeled with categories of potential students. The man’s head and shoulders remain visible at the top of the frame. The visual composition is typical of a social media promotional video, utilizing top and bottom margins for persistent titles and slogans. (5) The infographic fades out, returning the focus to the man in the studio. He continues to speak with high energy, using a variety of hand motions to illustrate the 'step-by-step' nature of the training. The persistent title '躺著賺? 不只是有 AI 當打工仔' remains at the top, along with a '廣告' (Ad) tag in the top right corner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with clear, high-arousal energy and a professional broadcast tone. Background music (BGM) is an upbeat electronic track with a steady, medium-fast tempo. (2) A sharp, digital 'pop' sound effect coincides with the appearance of the first graphic on screen. The music maintains its steady tempo of approximately 120 BPM, sitting clearly beneath the vocal layer in the mix. The speaker’s voice shows no signs of strain, maintaining a friendly yet authoritative tone throughout the explanation of AI's value. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the visual overlays change. The acoustic environment is a clean studio recording with zero ambient noise or room reverb, ensuring high signal-to-noise ratio. The music's rhythmic density increases slightly with added hi-hat patterns, complementing the speaker's increasingly persuasive prosody as he lists course modules. (4) A distinctive 'ding' notification-style sound effect triggers to highlight a new point in the presentation. The balance between the vocal track and the BGM is well-mastered, with the music ducking slightly to allow the speaker's voice to lead. The harmonic tension remains low and positive, utilizing major key sequences to evoke a sense of opportunity. (5) The speaker concludes with a final enthusiastic call-to-action, emphasizing the discount code. A final 'pop' sound effect marks the end of the text presentation. The music reaches a brief crescendo before a quick hard cut to silence at the very end of the clip, providing a professional and decisive finish to the advertisement.
